notes.title: Windows Slowdown Patch
notes.notes:
TripTrip Windows Patch

It's been a while

Hey there everyone! It's been a while. TripTrip's been out for almost 3 years now! Hard to believe.

Windows, y u do dis

Recently, it was brought to my attention that the game was only running at like 45fps instead of the 60fps it should have. That 45 fps is not just the framerate of the game, it's also the room speed in GameMaker - everything was running in slow motion!

This made the game frighteningly easy... and we can't have that. But more importantly, it caused some stuff with very specific timings to stop working properly.

If you're curious about the bug, there's some info about it over on YoyoGames' legacy GameMaker forums.

By the way...

As far as we know, no player has yet to reach the "Good Ending" of the game. This requires you to beat the game on Normal difficulty or higher after collecting all 9 bonus tokens.

Check out this random screenshot from the Good ending. How crazy is this?!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32810877/3809355e8e2d5e796540f1fdccd79e8450cd5dd7.png

It's pretty crazy. Whoa, check out this guy:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32810877/04be100b9bbb4e4119fdd88e672dccca58c17a9a.gif

Who the heck is that? Guess you'll have to beat the Good Ending to find out. If you send a screenshot of you beating the game's Good Ending to the About Airplane Twitter, I'll give you a shoutout to this audience (small as it is). I may even subscribe to your Twitch or something. Who knows. We'll see!

Anyway

Thanks for playing our game to whatever capacity you did play it. I think this post shows up for Wishlisters too. If you Wishlisted this game, thanks for that too! You're great. Are you somehow reading this without having bought or wishlisted the game? You're great too. Everyone's great.

Thanks,

Zach
Chief Airplane Officer
About Airplane LLC

notes.title: Welcome IndieGala players! + bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hey there! TripTrip is included in a recent bundle from IndieGala, and with that we've had a huge number of key activations. Welcome to the party, I hope you enjoy the game :)

In preparation for the IndieGala promotion, I did some work in the code to try to fix a long-running bug. If you played the game and experienced a random crash while fighting a boss or during the power unlock screen, I think we finally tracked down the cause of that. I haven't had one happen in a while! If you experience one starting today, please let us know so we can keep digging into it.

And finally, don't forget about the soundtrack DLC ;) we love the soundtrack, and we think you will too! We've uploaded a few of the tracks on YouTube if you want a sample.

So long!
